_doc: Advisories the npm audit gate in .github/workflows/security.yml may suppress. Every entry needs a GHSA id, the package, a reason, and an ISO expiry date. An expired entry FAILS the gate until it is renewed or removed, so each allowance gets re-reviewed. Only add entries that have no fixed release or that cannot reach shipped output.

advisories.reason: CVE-2026-93687 stack exhaustion on deeply nested brace patterns. braces 3.0.3 is both the latest release (Sep 2024) and the affected one; upstream fix PRs (micromatch/braces #78, #79, #82, #87, #88) are open and unmerged. Reached only through dev tooling (stylelint -> micromatch, nodemon -> chokidar 3) that expands patterns from our own config, never from user input, and nothing from it ships in dist/.
